decisions.reason: The connector inventory explicitly stated in message 320 is already represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY; the GPIO assignments require no additional inventory change.
The candidate's same-message MODIFY already records the button, switch, reset, touch-input, and BOOT-button details, including all applicable GPIO mappings.
Message 320 assigns panel-control and touch-input GPIOs but does not change the LED supply, level shifting, or GPIO5-controlled power logic.
The panel and touch GPIO mapping does not alter USB standalone-power activation, LDO capacity, or powered scope.
Message 320 contains no decision about local decoupling capacitors.
The GPIO mapping does not change the INA219 selection or the monitored 3.3V rail.
Message 320 does not address I2C series-resistor value, placement, population, or purpose.
The panel-control and touch GPIO assignments do not change the power sources, OR-ing method, diode requirement, or source-selection behavior.
Message 320 does not mention or supersede the GPIO13 charge-status indicator or its power-board connector circuitry.
The main-board panel GPIO mapping has no necessary effect on the battery connector, pin functions, placement, voltage range, or AXP2101 connection.
Message 320 does not change the interboard connector signals, pin-order policy, or unresolved physical power-connector numbering.
The source maps panel and touch inputs but does not change the existing GPIO5 assignment or any other switched-boost requirement.
